_doc: Fixed values for component-sync. Edit here only; the SKILL and snippets reference these.

figma.comment: Read-only. Resolve the page by pageId (robust to rename), then the set .<Component> by name on it; variables resolve by ID (names carry group paths, e.g. 'shadcn Default/primary'). Fill the snippet's PAGE_ID from pageId, SET_ID from S1.

code.comment: One folder per component: componentsDir/<name>/{<name>.tsx,.stories.tsx,.spec.tsx,index.ts}. cnUtils carries the 'text-format' twMerge group (the DS typo class must survive the rendered markup).
